name: postgres
description: Postgres MCP — read-only SQL queries against a Postgres database. Connection URL read from macOS keychain.
post_install_message:
Store the connection URL in macOS Keychain, then re-install this MCP:
  security add-generic-password -U -a "$USER" -s "POSTGRES_URL" -w
The final -w securely prompts for the URL. The installer reads it at launch; it is never stored in MCP config.
